component: one numerical accepted-feedback consumer with once-only account model invocation and durable acknowledgement
author: Supervisor operational scope, based on actual Controller integration recommendation; not R self-modification
expected_effect: Accepted real metrics and specific prior findings reach an actual Controller and yield a durable evidence-cited next decision; queue/transport alone not full-loop acceptance
protected: All existing source/scorer/worker/recorder/contracts/data/results; no incumbent mutation or eval/exec of model text; no protected data, external retrieval, paid API/provider, publication or promotion
input: Exact independently accepted recorder feedback/scorecard/review hashes, actual aggregate/fourfold/interval/coverage/energy and parent-relative supplement, immutable memory/history/pool, global authority and ownership/elapsed overhead. Bind every consumed file; no unreviewed or invented result

transport.account: Existing ChatGPT account login; no credentials/new paid provider
transport.prompt: Numerical evidence and existing-memory only; no tools/file/data/network/credentials access, no score/rule/permission change; structured non-executable scientific choice with exact accepted evidence references and consequences
transport.observed_tool_event_policy: Fail closed and preserve if any tool invocation appears; no claim that prompt/read-only enforces OS/protected-file isolation or that probe proves it
transport.model_attribution: New callable route explicitly pinned to local configured alias, not authenticated Astra or matched native-controller identity; no attribution of gains to model switch/R mechanism

response: Strict JSON schema including exact input bindings, evidence_used with finding and concrete choice consequence, one next candidate/actual parent/hypothesis/changes/expected evidence/bounded implementation, global2–3 active branches with reasons, memory additions, honest requested/unknown serving identity. Free method menu within fixed data/scorer/budget. Validate locally and never execute text
once_recovery: Exclusive claim before call; retain input/schema/raw JSONL/stderr/process identity/original response/usage/ack. Existing valid ack returns original choice; postclaim uncertainty never resamples automatically. Recover only hash-valid original completed response. Malformed/timeout/capacity/tool-use preserves failure, not scientific refutation
limits: Same outer6selected/24fits,deadline19:27:11UTC and selection cutoff19:12:11UTC; each call <=120seconds clipped to outerdeadline; at mostone call per accepted feedback ID, no retries or model/provider fallback. Account tokens/time reported separately; provider0/$0
smallness: One production module target<=180lines plus tests; actual diff/side-effects measured and >200lines requires explicit inseparability review. Existing journal/worker untouched
tests: Synthetic accepted numeric packet/hash and parent bindings; reject unreviewed/drifted/protected flags; onceclaim parallel/duplicate/timeout/malformed/tool events; crash after claim/response/before ack and same response recovery; deadline/sharedcap checks. Source tests/mocked CLI not real prediction-loop proof
continuation: After actual validated Controller choice, existing authorized Supervisor/native agent implementation and independent review handoffs must proceed to a fresh reviewed worker.execute. Log every Supervisor-operated handoff; no unavailable Python-to-agent API invented. Durable choice alone does not pass automatic experiment continuation
acceptance: Actual accepted numerical feedback -> actual model decision -> fresh admitted candidate execution AND demonstrably useful prior finding affecting that decision. Report memory reuse, H glue, predictor outcome and unproven researcher/process superiority separately
rollback: Do not activate new consumer; preserve its source/failure/onceclaim and fall back only to explicitly logged existing native Controller handoff, never silently resample the same account call or widen permissions
